beats.desc: a hand slides the new stainless deadbolt latch into the mortise pocket on the white door edge, its bolt entering the bore, while the other hand holds a blue-handled screwdriver ready at the faceplate
the fingers press the deadbolt latch faceplate flush into the door-edge mortise and steady it from the bore-hole side, the blue-handled screwdriver poised at the top mounting screw
beats.constraint: both hands stay at the door edge and the latch faceplate stays seated in the mortise.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt installs the new deadbolt latch into the door edge with a blue-handled screwdriver, working with both hands; the man
